notes.title: MUTANT COLLEGE IS RELEASING NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!!
We are excited to announce that Mutant College has just been released! We can't wait to share with you the result of this incredible journey.

In a world where 0.003% of the global population possesses mutant powers, attending a college for superheroes could be the opportunity of a lifetime—will you seize it? Mutant College is an adult visual novel that will immerse you in unique, thrilling, and engaging erotic experiences!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297278/d67a897671ce43a4796af365660cf59d9ef9daed.jpg[/img]

Thank you so much for your support.

Add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3291310/Mutant_College/]wishlist[/url] on Steam and get ready for an amazing adventure!

notes.title: Mutant College: my next game is coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Many of you have asked for information about my new project, so here I am, sharing a few details about Mutant College:

Mutant College will be a much larger game compared to Criminal Attraction and Mech Academy. First of all, there will be many more girls to develop relationships with—around 15. Each one, of course, has her own personality, desires, and kinks. Given the scale of the story and environments, I’ve decided to manage everything with a sandbox. I know what you’re thinking: “sandbox = grinding.” Absolutely not. The sandbox will be set up so that the gameplay and story are never slow or boring—trust me!

As for the story: you’ll live an adventure in the shoes of a mutant who has only recently discovered his powers. He finds himself attending Mutant College and, as tradition goes, every girl he meets will fall at his feet :). Mutant College won’t just let you experience a series of erotic adventures—a captivating underlying story will tie events together throughout. The MC will see his power grow to the point where he’ll have the potential to become a true hero.

The Steam page is already up! If you like the idea and want to support the development, add it to your wishlist—it will help me a lot to gauge your interest.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3291310/Mutant_College/]STEAM PAGE[/url]

Thank you all so much for the support you’ve given me over the years. None of this would be possible without you!
